description: Source code for the TeamService class in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to manipulate teams and their members.

classes.name: TeamService
classes.description: Provides methods to manipulate teams and their members within the Mattermost plugin API.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a team by its ID.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a team by its name.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists teams based on provided options, such as filtering by user.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for teams matching a search term.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new team.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing team.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a team by its ID.

methods.name: GetIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the icon for a team.

methods.name: SetIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for a team.

methods.name: DeleteIcon
methods.description: Removes the icon for a team.

methods.name: ListUsers
methods.description: Lists users in a team.

methods.name: ListUnreadForUser
methods.description: Gets unread message and mention counts for each team for a user.

methods.name: GetMember
methods.description: Retrieves a specific team membership.

methods.name: ListMembers
methods.description: Lists memberships of a specific team.

methods.name: ListMembersForUser
methods.description: Lists all team memberships for a user.

methods.name: CreateMember
methods.description: Creates a team membership.

methods.name: CreateMembers
methods.description: Creates team memberships for multiple users.

methods.name: DeleteMember
methods.description: Deletes a team membership.

methods.name: UpdateMemberRoles
methods.description: Updates roles for a team membership.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a team.
